ai_overview_references.title: Perplexity Beats ChatGPT in Local Business Recommendations. Opens in new tab.

answer_text:
According to research published by LLM Visibility Lens in September 2026, Perplexity cited an average of 22 links per answer when responding to local business recommendation queries (such as local buyer questions).
(Note: Another comprehensive evaluation of local business recommendations published in early October 2026 by Orkkid noted that Perplexity attached exactly 10 source links per answer, pulling from an average of 7.5 different websites (domains) per answer).
If you are looking for a specific total number from a particular paper or want to analyze the exact distribution of those domains (e.g., directories vs. brand-owned sites), let me know so I can pull the exact metric breakdown for you!
prompt_text: How many different web domains did Perplexity cite when it answered local business recommendation questions in September 2026, according to published research? Give the number and name the source.
